course.title: Hairdressing
course.tagline: Style, cut and care for women's hair: blowouts, treatments and salon-ready finishes.

days.title: Welcome to Hairdressing
days.goal: By the end of today you can explain and practise: Your kit is a dryer, round brushes, combs, clips, scissors, flat iron and heat protectant.

video.title: How to Do a Blowout

steps: Get your tools ready: round brush, hair dryer and flat iron.
Watch the video. It explains the main point in simple steps: Heat protectant must be applied before any hot tool touches hair.
Your kit is a dryer, round brushes, combs, clips, scissors, flat iron and heat protectant. Go slowly. Practise on a model or a practice head.
